question: You previously said that if Otto had gone to the Pleiades Watchtower, the difficulty of Arc 6 would have been considerably lower. How would things have changed? Would he have supported Subaru, for example?
answer:
Arc 6 is the highest-difficulty arc in Re:Zero!

Subaru died more times there than ever before, and because Subaru had grown so much during Arcs 4 and 5, I put him through all sorts of terrible situations in order to break his spirit. (laughs)

Otto and Garfiel didn't come to the Pleiades Watchtower, but if Otto had come, the whole sequence where Subaru acts alone and goes to read Reid's Book of the Dead—the incident that causes Subaru to lose his memories—would disappear entirely.

Subaru, having come up with the idea of reading Reid's book as a way to make progress in conquering the tower, would call Otto over and go read it together with him.

Since they'd discuss various things before going to read it, even if Subaru lost his memories, Otto would be able to explain the situation to him.

And unlike the main story, where Subaru is bewildered after losing his memories because he's surrounded by beautiful men and women, seeing Otto's face would actually make Subaru feel relieved. (laughs)

Subaru would take longer to become cornered. So we left that guy behind!
